errors.name: InvalidOrderLineError
errors.description: Raised when an order line contains invalid data such as an invalid product ID, negative quantity, or invalid unit price.

errors.name: OrderLineNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to reference an order line that does not exist in the order's line collection.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to look up an order by order_id that does not exist in the system.
